title: Cerca Trova
summary: Leonardo's lost Battle of Anghiari is sealed in the page's DOM and surfaces only when your browser's Find-in-page seeks the word on Vasari's flag.
mechanism: HTML hidden="until-found" plus the beforematch event: an unrendered DOM region revealed solely by the browser's native Find-in-page, drawing a per-visit sanguine canvas mural on reveal.
references: Leonardo da Vinci, The Battle of Anghiari (1505, lost)
Giorgio Vasari, The Battle of Marciano / the 'cerca trova' flag (1563)
Maurizio Seracini, the search behind the Palazzo Vecchio wall
net.art (the browser's Find function as material)
